network.title: Network
network.intro: Alumni of other colleges on {{app}}, your intros, your verified credentials and what you share with employers. Only what you choose, only while you choose.
network.minor: The network is for members aged 18 and over.
network.pausedBody: Two alumni reported intros from you. Your college will review it and can turn it back on.

alumni.collegeOff: Your college has not joined the network
alumni.collegeOffBody: When your college turns on alumni discovery, you can find alumni of other colleges here.
alumni.joinBody: Turn on “Be found by other colleges” in Settings. Then you can find alumni of other colleges and ask them for help.
alumni.noneBody: Try another company, or fewer words.

ask.title: Ask {{name}}
ask.description: Your name, college, branch and batch go with the request. No contact details.
ask.noteHint: At most {{n}} characters. Only the alumnus reads it.
ask.sent: Sent to {{name}}. You will hear when they answer.

goals.company_insight: What it is like at the company

intros.left: You can send {{n}} more this week.

none.sent: You have not asked anyone yet

intros.acceptBody: Choose what this one student may see. Nothing else about you is shared.

credentials.intro: Signed by your college and checkable by anyone with the link: share them on LinkedIn or with an employer. They show only what the college verified, never a salary or contact details.
credentials.off: Your college has not turned on verified credentials
credentials.offBody: When it does, you can turn your verified offers, readiness milestones and certificates into credentials.

employers.intro: Employer drives your college approved. Share your résumé and readiness with an employer only if you want to; you can stop at any time.
employers.collegeOff: Your college has not turned on employer access
employers.collegeOffBody: When it does, drives from employers your college approved appear in Placements.
employers.consentFirst: To share with employers, turn on “Employers my college approved can see what I share” in Settings.
employers.noneBody: Register for a drive from an employer posting in Placements, then share it here.

settings.discoveryBody: Students and alumni of other colleges that joined the network can find the fields below and ask you for help.
settings.employers: Employers my college approved can see what I share
settings.employersBody: Employers see counts that include you, and your résumé and readiness only for drives where you share them.
settings.revocable: You can turn these off at any time: you disappear at once. Never available under 18.
settings.linkedinHint: Shown on your card, and offered when you accept an intro.
settings.viewedNone: No employer has opened your résumé or readiness.

admin.intro: The network connects your college with other colleges and with employers you approve. Nothing is shared until you turn it on, and you can turn it off at any time.
admin.switchesTitle: What the college takes part in
admin.terms: I accept the network terms (version {{v}}) on behalf of the college.

switches.alumniDiscoveryBody: Students and alumni who opt in can find, and be found by, members of other colleges.
switches.employerAccessBody: Verified employers can offer postings to the college; you approve each one before students see it.
switches.credentialsBody: The college signs credentials members ask for: offers, readiness milestones, certificates.

admin.members: Members who opted in: {{discoverable}} findable by other colleges, {{employers}} visible to employers.
admin.noPostings: No employer has offered a posting yet.
admin.approveBody: Approving creates a placement drive in the college. You run it as usual: eligibility, registrations, rounds and offers.
admin.approved: Approved: the drive is in Admin › Placement drives.
admin.pausedBody: Two alumni of other colleges reported their intros. Review it with them, then turn access back on.
admin.activityNone: Nobody outside the college has read anything yet.
admin.keysBody: {{issued}} valid credentials, {{revoked}} revoked. Old keys keep checking the credentials they signed.

pending.applied: Confirm your email and your domain (Company tab). A person then checks your GSTIN and approves you.
pending.verified: Your email and domain are confirmed. A person is checking your GSTIN; you will hear when you are approved.
pending.suspended: Your company is suspended. Postings and candidates are hidden. Write to the platform to ask why.

new.title: New posting
new.body: Colleges approve each posting before their students see it.
new.ctcHint: As you want students to see it, for example “6 to 8 LPA”.

publish.title: Offer to colleges
publish.body: Each college decides. Approved postings become drives the college runs.
publish.noColleges: No college takes postings from you right now.

pool.intro: How many students who opted in fit, college by college. Counts only: under five shows as “<5”, larger counts are rounded down to five.
pool.privacy: No names or profiles: students share their résumé only when they apply to your drive.

company.emailPending: Work email not confirmed yet: use the link we emailed.
company.dns: Add this TXT record to {{domain}}, then check it:
company.prices: Prices: {{posting}} a posting, {{drive}} a drive, {{hire}} a hire.
company.name: Name
company.added: We emailed them a link to set a password.

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.intro: Students who applied through their college and chose to share with you. Contact them through the college’s placement cell.
candidates.readinessNote: Worked out now by the college; not stored.

apply.title: Hire through {{app}}
apply.intro: Reach students who opted in, through their colleges. We confirm your work email and domain, and a person checks your GSTIN before you are approved.

fields.legalName: Legal name (as on the GST registration)
fields.name: Your name

apply.freeMail: Use your company’s own domain, not a mail provider.
apply.badGstin: This is not a valid GSTIN.
apply.privacy: We keep what you enter to check your company and to bill you. Students’ contact details are never shared with employers.
apply.doneBody: We sent a link to {{email}} to set your password. Then sign in at {{host}}, turn on two-factor sign-in and confirm your domain.

platform.title: Employers
platform.intro: Approve employers after checking their GSTIN on the GST portal. Suspended employers lose access at once.
platform.gstCheck: Check the legal name and GSTIN on the GST portal before approving.
